summary: Reject ambiguous OpenAPI JSON and expand evidence parser properties
details: Reject duplicate decoded JSON object keys at root and nested levels in focused OpenAPI ingestion and worker replay, including escaped spellings of the same key.
Add or strengthen seven bounded seeded parser fuzz targets for CycloneDX, SPDX, VEX, scanner normalization and scope probing, and both production OpenAPI owners.

Check repeated and serialized projections, partial-reader parity, applicable structural and result-count limits, and digest-bound OpenAPI source and durable replay checks while preserving fixture provenance.

compatibility.notes: Reject ambiguous duplicate-key OpenAPI JSON while retaining valid projections and existing YAML loader compatibility. No parser-version, hash, durable schema or immutable raw-evidence changes. Historical duplicate-key payloads now fail replay; they are not rewritten. Fuzz workload budgets do not narrow production acceptance.

security: Reject ambiguous untrusted evidence before interpretation; retain generic errors, bounded digest-checked source reads, reader cleanup, and disabled external references. Fuzz callbacks use no provider, database, credentials or customer data.
limitations: Short bounded campaigns supplement deterministic vectors and do not prove exhaustive standards conformance or security.
YAML characterization covers an existing valid OpenAPI fixture; it does not establish general YAML duplicate-key rejection or conformance.
Cryptographic/archive properties and complete scheduled campaign orchestration remain tracked by EVY-1109 and EVY-1110.
